answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 65414 Country: India Title: How to offer salah missed during a journey? Question: What is the procedure/process/hadith in respect of salah which were missed during a journey? Answer ID: 65414 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 818/924/L=08/1437) Qada is similar to ada (in performing), so as much salah you have missed during a journey offer them and offer them with qasr i.e. pray the salah of four rakah only two rakah. There is no qaza of sunnah salah. Yes, there is qadha of witr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
